overview.description: The State Street SPDR Dow Jones International Real Estate ETF (RWX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in real estate equity. The fund tracks a market-cap-weighted index of firms involved in the ownership and operation of real estate internationally, excluding the United States. RWX was launched on Dec 14, 2006 and is issued by State Street.
